mapper.select: SELECT b.*,e.employee_name executor_name FROM migration_batch b JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=b.executed_by WHERE b.batch_id=#{id}

SELECT b.*,e.employee_name executor_name FROM migration_batch b JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=b.executed_by WHERE b.file_hash=#{hash} AND b.status IN ('COMPLETED','COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS') ORDER BY b.batch_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT b.*,e.employee_name executor_name FROM migration_batch b JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=b.executed_by AND b.status=#{status} ORDER BY b.batch_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_batch AND status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE migration_batch SET status=#{status},total_count=#{total},success_count=#{success},failure_count=#{failure},completed_at=#{completedAt},dedup_key=CASE WHEN #{clearDedup}=TRUE THEN NULL ELSE dedup_key END,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE batch_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO migration_error(batch_id,staging_id,row_no,field_name,error_code,error_message,raw_value) VALUES (#{e.batchId},(SELECT staging_id FROM migration_staging WHERE batch_id=#{e.batchId} AND row_no=#{e.rowNo}),#{e.rowNo},#{e.fieldName},#{e.errorCode},#{e.errorMessage},#{e.rawValue})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM migration_staging WHERE batch_id=#{id} AND validation_status='VALID' ORDER BY row_no
SELECT * FROM migration_error WHERE batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY row_no,migration_error_id
SELECT customer_id FROM customer WHERE business_registration_no=#{businessNo}

SELECT e.employee_id FROM employee e JOIN employee_role er ON er.employee_id=e.employee_id JOIN `role` r ON r.role_id=er.role_id WHERE e.employee_no=#{employeeNo} AND e.active=TRUE AND r.active=TRUE AND r.role_code='SALES' LIMIT 1
SELECT b.*,e.employee_name executor_name FROM migration_batch b JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id=b.executed_by ORDER BY b.batch_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
